q102.question: Please tell me in detail about the three life-implantation sites in The Urantia Book, the circumstances, and the developments that followed.
q102.answer:
The three life-implantation sites of Urantia (the earth) described in The Urantia Book, the circumstances at the time, and the subsequent course of evolutionary development are as follows.

1. The Background of Life Implantation and the Environmental Conditions

Designation as a decimal experimental planet: Urantia is the 606th inhabited world of the system of Satania and also a decimal planet (a life-experiment planet), one out of every ten being so designated [49:0.3, 58:0.1]. It is a sphere on which experiments modifying and improving the standard universe life designs are permitted [58:0.1].

Physical and chemical preparation: About 600 million years ago a commission of Life Carriers sent from Jerusem surveyed the environment of Urantia [58:1.1]. Because protoplasm of the Urantia type can function only in a suitable saline solution, they waited until the salinity of the inland seas had reached the proper level and shallow tropical bays and lagoons had formed [58:1.3, 58:1.6-1.7].

2. The Three Life-Implantation Sites and the Circumstances at the Time

The time of implantation: About 550 million years ago, the corps of Life Carriers returned and, in co-operation with supermaterial and spiritual forces, planted the original marine life patterns native to the earth [58:4.2, 58:4.5].

The implantation sites: Life was implanted simultaneously in three places in the central sea that divided east and west the great continental mass then breaking up, that is, in warm, shallow, sheltered tropical inlets (protected waters) [58:4.2, 58:4.4, 65:2.1, 65:2.13].

Central region: Eurasia-Africa [58:4.2]

Eastern region: Australasia (the Australian and Antarctic group) [58:4.2]

Western region: Greenland and the Americas [58:4.2]

The purpose of the implantation: The protoplasm planted in the three regions was an original and identical life implantation, and the purpose was to ensure that, when the great continents later drifted and separated completely, each continent would carry this life with it in its warm waters [58:4.2, 58:4.4].

3. The Stage-by-Stage Development after Life Implantation

① The establishment of plant life and the transition to animals (500 to 450 million years ago)

By 500 million years ago primitive marine vegetation was well established [58:4.3], and 450 million years ago, in the shallow seas and lagoons of the separating continents, the gradual transition from plant to animal took place [58:6.1]. Sponges and the like appeared at this time as borderline transitional organisms [65:2.2].

② The appearance of multicellular animals and trilobites (400 million years ago / the Cambrian)

400 million years ago the trilobites, the first multicellular animals, suddenly evolved and dominated the seas [59:1.4]. The characteristics of animals originating from the three implantation regions began to show slightly different regional features among the Western Hemisphere, Eurasian, and Australasian groups [59:1.14].

③ The appearance of vertebrates (fishes), amphibians, reptiles, and mammals

Fishes (250 million years ago): The fishes, the first vertebrates, appeared in the northern seas [59:4.9-4.10].

Amphibians (210 million years ago): As the swim bladders of primitive arthropods that crawled out of the sea onto the land evolved into lungs, air-breathing amphibians such as frogs appeared [59:5.5-5.6]. The frog is one of the oldest land-vertebrate ancestors of humankind that have survived to the present day [65:2.7].

Reptiles and mammals (140 to 50 million years ago): After the age of reptiles (dinosaurs), the placental mammals suddenly appeared 50 million years ago from agile, leaping dinosaur ancestors [60:1.9, 61:0.1, 61:1.2, 65:2.12].

4. The Fate of the Three Life Lines and the Final Appearance of Humankind

The lines that started from the three life-implantation sites met different fates over time, as follows.

The limitations of the eastern implantation line: The organisms of the eastern life implantation at first developed favorably up to the prehuman level, but when the highest types of germ plasm suffered repeated and irretrievable losses, they lost their potential for intellectual development and their growth was limited [65:2.13-2.14].

The union of the western and central lines:

The higher mammals (the lemur stock) that were to become the direct ancestors of humankind developed most excellently chiefly from the western life implantation (North America) [62:0.1, 65:2.13, 65:2.15].

This western line crossed the Bering land bridge and migrated southwest along the coast of Asia [62:1.2, 65:2.15].

In the paradisiacal environment west of India (the Mesopotamian/Persian peninsula), the line of western origin and the superior line of the central life implantation united to form the final ancestral human line [62:0.1, 62:1.2, 65:2.15].

The appearance of the first human beings (Andon and Fonta) (about one million years ago):

About one million years ago (exactly 993,419 years ago), Andon and Fonta, the first true human beings, were born of primate twins isolated in southwestern Asia [62:5.1, 62:5.2, 63:0.1].

When, at about the age of ten, they responded to the adjutant mind-spirits of worship and wisdom and made volitional choices, Urantia was at last registered in the universe of Nebadon as an official inhabited planet peopled by will creatures [62:6.5, 62:7.3, 62:7.7].

q103.question: The specific circumstances by which the earth and the other planets were ejected from the sun when the Angona system approached 4.5 billion years ago, and the nuclear reactions taking place within the sun and the role of the element calcium
q103.answer:
The specific details of how the solar system was born through the approach of the Angona system about 4.5 billion years ago, and of the nuclear reactions within the sun and the cosmic role of the element calcium, are as follows.

1. The Approach of the Angona System 4.5 Billion Years Ago and the Birth of the Solar System (Monmatia)

The approach of the Angona system: About 4.5 billion years ago the Angona system, an enormous dark giant of space, solid and highly charged, began to approach our sun, which was then isolated.

Tidal convulsions and the ejection of a gas column: At that time the sun was in a state of variable-star pulsation, swelling and contracting on a three-and-a-half-day cycle, and so was very sensitive to outside gravitational stimuli. As Angona drew steadily nearer over some 500,000 years, enormous tongues of solar gas were ejected into space at each moment of the sun's maximum expansion during its pulsations.

The formation of the twelve planets: When Angona made its closest approach, enormous tidal extrusions took place on both sides of the sun. The gas drawn out toward Angona was permanently detached from the sun in the form of a gigantic gas column, pointed at both ends and bulging in the middle.

From the condensation nuclei at the two tapering ends of the gas column, five inner planets and five outer planets were formed.

From the bulging middle portion came the giant planets Jupiter and Saturn, and for a time after their formation these two planets functioned like secondary suns, giving off their own light.

The capture of foreign bodies and retrograde motion: By its powerful gravity the sun wrested three bodies belonging to the Angona system and included them in its own planetary family. Collisions of bodies during this process introduced the exceptional phenomenon of retrograde motion (clockwise revolution/rotation) among the bodies of the solar system.

The characteristics of the orbital plane: The reason the planets of the solar system revolve not in the plane of the sun's equator but along an inclined plane is likewise that the planets were drawn out not by the sun's rotation but along the plane of the solar extrusion formed at the time of Angona's approach.

2. The Nuclear Reactions within the Sun and the Role of the Element Calcium

The solar interior at 35 million degrees and its nuclear reactions: The temperature at the center of the sun reaches about 35 million degrees Fahrenheit (℉) and generates enormous X rays. Under this high temperature and pressure, intact atoms cannot exist and are broken down into subatomic particles.

The most common mechanism of solar energy release is the hydrogen-carbon-helium reaction.

The carbon nucleus can hold up to four protons; when hydrogen particles penetrate the carbon nucleus and saturate it, it releases them in the form of a helium atom. In this process the carbon itself is not used up but serves as an energy catalyst converting hydrogen into helium.

The acrobatic escape mechanism of the element calcium:

Calcium is the basic building material of space and the planets (stone dust), most abundantly permeating the whole space of the superuniverse of Orvonton.

Although the calcium atom is a relatively heavy particle with 20 electrons, it is the "expert solar jail-breaker," the best at escaping through the sun's powerful gravity into space.

The acrobatics of the electrons: After losing one of its outer electrons, the calcium atom performs an amazing acrobatic feat, throwing its nineteenth electron back and forth between the nineteenth and twentieth orbits some 25,000 times a second.

Through this delicate electronic motion the calcium atom partially defies gravity and escapes out of the sun by riding the stream of light and energy, catching and letting go of the solar rays 25,000 times a second.

Because of this calcium escape activity, a layer of gaseous calcium (stone) some 6,000 miles thick is formed at the surface of the sun.

q104.question: What does The Urantia Book mean when it says there are twelve planets in the Monmatia solar system? Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto makes only nine.
q104.answer:
When The Urantia Book explains that there were twelve planets in Monmatia (the solar system), it refers to the number of basic planets that were born by condensing directly from the column of primordial gas ejected from the sun when the Angona system approached about 4.5 billion years ago.

The reasons this differs from the familiar structure of nine planets (eight officially today), "Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto," are as follows.

1. The Formation Structure of the Original Twelve Planets (5 + 2 + 5)

The enormous column of solar gas drawn out of the sun by the gravitational pull of Angona was slender at both ends and swollen in the middle.

The giant planets in the middle (2): From the most swollen central portion of the column came the giant planets Jupiter and Saturn.

The inner and outer planets (10): From the condensation nuclei at the tapering ends of the column on either side, five inner planets and five outer planets were formed respectively.

In this way a total of twelve original planets were assembled from the gas column of the primitive solar system.

2. The Vanished "Fifth Planet" and the Asteroid Belt

Why, then, are there not twelve today? According to The Urantia Book, it is because one of the twelve planets was destroyed in a cosmic catastrophe.

The disruption of the fifth planet: The fifth planet of the solar system, which lay between Mars and Jupiter, traveled in an irregular orbit and periodically came closer and closer to Jupiter.

Finally, when it reached the critical point of Jupiter's powerful gravity-tidal disruption limit, this fifth planet was suddenly shattered to pieces.

The fragments of this destroyed fifth planet came to form the asteroid belt that today circles in the orbit between Mars and Jupiter.

3. The Capture of Bodies from the Angona System

In addition, at the time of its formation the solar system wrested by gravity three foreign bodies (planets) from the approaching Angona system and added them to its own planetary family. As an aftereffect of these collisions and captures, the phenomenon of retrograde motion, revolving or rotating in a clockwise direction, was introduced into some bodies of the solar system.

💡 Summary

Modern science has traditionally counted nine planets (eight officially since the reclassification of Pluto in 2006) and regards the asteroid belt as merely a cluster of rocks, but The Urantia Book explains things on the basis of the structure of twelve fundamental planets born from the primordial solar gas column, including the "fifth planet" that was shattered into the asteroid belt.

q105.question: It is said that the nuclear remnant of the mother nebula still gives light and heat to its remnant planetary family of 165 worlds (57:4.9). What does "165 worlds" refer to?
q105.answer:
The "165 worlds" appearing in Paper 57, Section 4, paragraph 9 of The Urantia Book do not mean the earth or the planets of our solar system (Monmatia); they refer to the 165 remnant planets that still revolve directly around the central nuclear remnant of the Andronover nebula, the mother body that produced our sun [57:1.1, 57:4.9].

The specific cosmic background and meaning are as follows.

1. The Andronover Nebula and the Birth of the Suns

Over long ages of contraction and rotation, the Andronover nebula threw out into space, in two generations (the primary and secondary ejections), a total of 1,013,628 suns ("lords of light") and made them independent [57:4.3, 57:4.8, 57:4.9].

About 6 billion years ago, in the course of the secondary terminal disruptions of the Andronover nebula, our sun was born as the 1,013,572nd sun and left the nebula to become independent [57:4.8].

2. The Identity of the "Nuclear Remnant of the Mother Nebula" and the "165 Worlds"

After more than a million suns had been ejected, the "terminal nuclear remnant" that remained last at the center of the nebula did not vanish completely but remained as a single central body glowing with a reddish light [57:4.9].

The last planetary family, which has not escaped the gravitational domain of this venerable nuclear remnant of the mother nebula but remains as its offspring, revolving around that center to this day, consists of the 165 worlds (planets) [57:4.9].

This nuclear remnant of the mother nebula still sustains the 165 remnant planets that it directly holds by emitting a gentle light and heat to them [57:4.9].

In summary, the expression refers to "the central nucleus of the Andronover mother nebula," which gave birth to more than a million suns and is now cooling with a red glow, and to "the last 165 planetary family members" held directly by that center and still revolving around it [57:4.8, 57:4.9].

q106.question: From the lemur to the first human beings, how did humans come into being?
q106.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, humans are not a mere product of chance or a direct transformation from the apes; they came into being about a million years ago through three successive and sudden mutations that began in the North American lemur stock.

The specific process from the lemurs to the appearance of Andon and Fonta, the first human beings, is as follows.

1. The Early Lemurs and the Migration to Southwestern Asia

The origin in the North American lemur type: About 50 million years ago, in the age of mammals, placental mammals of the lemur type evolved in North America. They were not the direct ancestors of the modern lemurs; both branched off from a common ancient ancestor.

Migration to Asia and isolation: The North American lemurs crossed the Bering land bridge, moved southwestward along the coast of Asia, and reached the pleasant highlands west of India (the present Mesopotamian/Persian peninsula). Later, as the surrounding coasts were submerged, they were isolated in this utopian region, and here, by uniting with the superior stock of the central life implantation, they formed the ancestral line of humankind.

2. The First Mutation: The Dawn Mammals

Appearance (a little more than a million years ago): In the seventieth generation of the lemur ancestors, the first mutation, the dawn mammals, suddenly appeared.

Physical and behavioral characteristics: They were about 3 feet (about 90 cm) tall and could easily stand erect, though not habitually. They were hairy and agile and relished meat.

Characteristics of the hands and feet: They had an opposable thumb (a thumb able to grasp objects) and a grasping big toe. (From this point on, the human line continued to develop the thumb and lost the grasping function of the toe, while the apes retained the grasping toe but failed to develop the thumb.)

Intelligence and emotions: They had the largest brain in proportion to body size, developed curiosity, conceit, fear, tribal spirit, and pugnacity in defending the home, and built rough shelters in the tops of tall trees to escape the dangers of the ground.

3. The Second Mutation: The Mid-Mammals and the Divergence from the Apes

Appearance (70 generations after the dawn mammals): In the treetop shelter of a superior pair of dawn mammals, twins, a brother and a sister (a male and a female), were born, and with them the mid-mammals began.

Physical characteristics: They grew to over 4 feet (about 120 cm) in height, had almost no hair on their bodies, and their legs lengthened while their arms shortened, so that they became fully adapted to upright walking. Their hands had an almost fully opposable thumb.

Way of life: Displaying constructive tendencies, they built not only treetop shelters but also underground shelters in the form of tunnels. They had the habit of collecting smooth, round pebbles for use as weapons or for defense.

The divergence of the apes and the human line:

While the mid-mammal group was flourishing greatly, two pairs of twins were born at the same time.

The inferior twins: They shunned hunting and meat-eating and went off to the tropical fruit regions of the south, and their descendants became the modern simian tribes (monkeys, baboons, chimpanzees, gorillas).

The superior twins: They formed the ascending line leading to humankind. (In other words, The Urantia Book makes clear that humans did not evolve from the apes but are the descendants of different twins who branched off from a common ancestor, the mid-mammals.)

4. The Third Mutation: The Primates

Appearance (while the mid-mammals were flourishing): In a crisis in which lightning struck a tree, a leading pair of mid-mammals migrated to another region, and from them superior twins, a brother and a sister, were born, with whom the primate species appeared.

Physical and intellectual characteristics: They were over 5 feet (about 150 cm) tall and walked fully erect from just after birth. Their heads were larger and they had less hair, and the structure of their hands and feet was completed in the human pattern.

Language and migration: At about fourteen years of age they went west and set up a home, founding the primate species, and they communicated by gestures and vocal symbols. They lived mainly on the ground, but at night they slept in the trees for safety.

5. The Birth of the First True Human Beings: Andon and Fonta

Time of birth: About 21,000 years (about 900 generations) after the origin of the primates, twins Andon and Fonta, the first two true human beings, were born of a primate pair. (Exactly 993,419 years before A.D. 1934, that is, about a million years ago.)

Physical characteristics: They had a fully human type of thumb and foot structure, and they mainly walked and ran rather than climbing trees. They matured at twelve, and their potential life span was about 75 years.

New human emotions and decisions:

In addition to sympathy, shame, love, and jealousy, the "worshipful emotions" such as awe, reverence, humility, and gratitude appeared for the first time.

By about the age of ten they had developed a language of gestures and sounds conveying fifty ideas, and they voluntarily decided to break away from their inferior animal relatives and migrate northward.

Andon and Fonta were the first to invent a way of making fire for themselves by striking flint sparks into a dry bird's nest.

6. Mental and Spiritual Significance and Cosmic Recognition

The operation of the adjutant mind-spirits:

From the lemurs to the primates, only the first five adjutant spirits (intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel) functioned, at the level of the animal mind.

When Andon and Fonta reached the age of ten, the sixth adjutant spirit, "the spirit of worship," made contact with their minds for the first time in the history of Urantia.

At about eleven years of age, when they made the voluntary choice to flee northward with purpose, the seventh adjutant spirit, "the spirit of wisdom," began to function.

Registration as an inhabited world: As soon as the human mind endowed with will appeared, a communication circuit to the capital of the universe of Nebadon (Salvington) was automatically established, and Urantia was officially registered in the universe as the 606th inhabited planet of the system of Satania.

The indwelling of the Thought Adjusters: Andon and Fonta received divine Thought Adjusters (fragments of the spirit of God) as a gift, and after death, passing through the mansion worlds, they became immortal beings who survive eternally

q107.question: How did the primitive civilization of the Andonic clans and the six colored races (the Sangik races) appear?
q107.answer:
1. The Nineteen Children of Andon and Fonta, the First Humans, and the Early Primitive Civilization of the "Andonic Clans"

① The first family and the nineteen children

The first child, Sontad: Two years after they had fled north from the primate tribe, Sontad, the first child of Andon and Fonta, was born. Sontad was the first baby born on Urantia (the earth) to be wrapped in a protective covering (a cloth) at birth.

Children and dwelling place: Andon and Fonta had nineteen children in all, and they enjoyed seeing some fifty grandchildren and six great-grandchildren. The family lived together in four half-cave shelters dug out of limestone with flint tools and connected by passageways.

The death of Andon and Fonta: In their forty-second year, Andon and Fonta lost their lives, together with five of their children and eleven grandchildren, when a violent earthquake brought down the overhanging limestone rock. Their eldest son, Sontad, though injured, became the leader of the clan and buried his parents and family by heaping up a mound of stones.

② The characteristics of the primitive civilization of the Andonic clans

Physical characteristics and clothing: They had dark eyes and a swarthy skin (melanin pigment) mixed with a slight tinge of yellow and red, and in appearance they most closely resembled the modern Eskimos. To endure the cold, they were the first in the history of the earth to make and wear clothing of animal skins.

The invention of artificial fire: Striking flints, Andon sent sparks flying into a discarded dry bird's nest and so kindled the first artificial fire in the history of the earth. Thanks to fire, they were able to overcome the cold northern environment and become completely independent of their inferior animal relatives to the south.

The invention of tools and hunting: Andon invented the "stone ax (hammer)" by binding a piece of flint to a club with animal tendons, and his descendants discovered and used the throwing stick and the harpoon. They lived a hunting life, eating nothing but the meat they hunted, apart from wild fruits.

Language and clan culture: They developed a language of gestures and sounds conveying about fifty ideas, and they coined new words daily in keeping with new inventions and adaptations. Their friendship and clan consciousness were very strong and their love of their children was exceptional, but they had no sense of humor and no hearty laughter. (Humor was a later legacy brought by the Adamic race.)

Onagar and the first spiritual revival: Tens of thousands of years after the appearance of Andon, Onagar (born about 983,323 years ago), the first great teacher, appeared. He ended the wars among the clans and trained the first missionaries, who spread the worship of "the Breath Giver" (God) and the teaching of the afterlife ("the Great Beyond"). He was also the first to teach the cooking of meat by roasting it over the fire.

2. How the Six Colored Races (the Sangik Races) Appeared 500,000 Years Ago

① The background of their appearance: The terrible wars of the Badonan tribes

The Badonan tribes: Of the line of a great-great-grandson of Andon, they lived in the highlands of northwestern India and were superior Andonite descendants who did not offer human sacrifices.

The hundred-year racial war: About 500,000 years ago a ruthless racial war broke out among the highland Badonan tribes and lasted more than a hundred years; when the war ended, only a hundred families of superior survivors remained.

② The simultaneous mutation in one family (the Sangik family)

The nineteen Sangik children: To one surviving Badonan couple were born nineteen Sangik children, who were unusually intelligent and whose skins took on different colors from one another when exposed to sunlight.

The first exceptional event in the system of Satania: On an ordinary evolutionary planet the six colored races appear one after another, from the red to the indigo race, over hundreds of thousands of years, but on Urantia they appeared simultaneously as nineteen children in one family.

The proportion of skin colors: Five red, two orange, four yellow, two green, four blue, and two indigo children were born.

③ The characteristics and historical course of the six colored races

The red man (a primary race): The most intelligent of the Sangiks, they were the first to develop civilization and government and adhered to monogamy. After wars with the yellow man they crossed the Bering land bridge, migrated to the American continent, and were isolated there (great leader: Onamonalonton).

The orange man (a secondary race): They had a strong and peculiar urge to build, heaping up great piles of stones and mounds, but after migrating to Africa they fought a hundred-year war with the green race and were the first to be completely exterminated, about 100,000 years ago (leader: Porshunta).

The yellow man (a primary race): They were the first to give up hunting and to establish agriculture and settled homes, and they excelled in solidarity and social co-operation. They occupied eastern Asia and formed what is today Chinese civilization (leader: Singlangton).

The green man (a secondary race): They included a giant strain reaching 8 to 9 feet in height, but they were somewhat inferior in ability. They scattered in three branches and, after destroying the orange race, were finally absorbed into the indigo race and disappeared (leader: Fantad).

The blue man (a primary race): They invented the spear and excelled in art and toolmaking. They migrated to Europe, absorbed the Neanderthals, and became the Cro-Magnons, and later, uniting with the violet race (the Adamites), became the chief biological foundation of the modern white (Caucasoid) peoples (leader: Orlandof).

The indigo man (a secondary race / the black race): Of the Sangiks they were the last to leave their homeland, and they took possession of the whole African continent (leader: Orvonon).

q108.question: What were the Planetary Prince Caligastia and his staff, and the civilization of Dalamatia, like?
q108.answer:
1. The Arrival of the Planetary Prince Caligastia and His Staff of One Hundred

The background and purpose of the arrival: About 500,000 years ago, when the population of the earth had reached about half a billion, Caligastia, a secondary Lanonandek Son, was sent as the Planetary Prince of Urantia. Together with his associate, Daligastia, he came with the mission of leading primitive humankind from hunters to herdsmen and farmers and of developing culture and civilization.

The corporeal staff of one hundred: Of the more than 785,000 ascendant citizens of Jerusem, the system capital, who volunteered, one hundred (fifty men and fifty women) were chosen as Caligastia's staff.

Repersonalization and physical bodies: These one hundred received transplants of the life plasm extracted from one hundred superior descendants of Andon and Fonta (fifty men and fifty women), and in ten days they were repersonalized as superhuman beings possessing actual bodies of flesh and blood.

Diet and the maintenance of immortality: They ate only a vegetarian diet, and by partaking of the fruit of the "tree of life," brought from Edentia and planted in the central temple court, they did not age and maintained physical immortality.

2. The First World Capital, "Dalamatia"

Location and architecture: It was established in the region of the Persian Gulf (Mesopotamia) of that time and was called "Dalamatia" after the Prince's associate, Daligastia. It was surrounded by a wall forty feet high, and in it were ten residential districts and, in the very center of the city, the three-story "temple of the unseen Father."

The introduction of the seven-day week: The Dalamatia teachers divided the twenty-eight-day lunar month into four parts, introducing the seven-day week for the first time in the history of the earth and providing a day for spiritual worship.

The appearance of the primary midwayers: Through the nonsexual (morontia-soul) union of the men and women of the staff, a corps of 50,000 primary midway creatures, invisible to human eyes but helping in the administration of the planet, was born in this period.

3. The Systematic Uplift by the Ten Planetary Councils

The staff of one hundred formed ten autonomous councils of ten members each and developed human society in many directions.

The council on food and material welfare (chairman: Ang): Instruction in irrigation, well digging, the treatment of skins, and weaving.

The board of animal domestication (chairman: Bon): The taming of wild animals and the fostering of animal husbandry.

The advisers regarding the conquest of predatory animals: The building of defensive systems to protect people from ferocious beasts.

The faculty of dissemination and conservation of knowledge (chairman: Fad): The spreading of the alphabet, the system of knowledge, and writing.

The commission on industry and trade (chairman: Nod): The regulation of barter and the development of early industry.

The college of revealed religion (chairman: Hap): The replacement of fear (ghost worship) with the worship of God, and the promulgation of "the Father's prayer" and hymns of worship.

The board of health and sanitation (chairman: Lut): The introduction of a weekly cleansing bath and of the handshake as a sign of friendship.

The council on art and science (chairman: Mek): The rudiments of physics and chemistry, the making of pottery, and the elevation of aesthetic ideals.

The council on improved tribal government (chairman: Tut): The regulation of warfare and the promotion of peaceful federation among tribes.

The supreme court of racial co-ordination (chairman: Van): Serving as the supreme court mediating planet-wide matters and racial conflicts.

The policy of evolutionary acceleration: The one hundred held to a policy not of radical revelation or revolution but of naturally accelerating social evolution, gathering the superior young people of the surrounding tribes into the schools of Dalamatia, educating them, and sending them back as leaders.

4. The Tragic Interruption and the Submergence of Dalamatia

Three hundred thousand years of prosperity and the rebellion: The civilization of Dalamatia prospered peacefully for about 300,000 years, but about 200,000 years ago it met with great tragedy when the Planetary Prince Caligastia joined the rebellion of Lucifer, the System Sovereign.

The division of the staff: Of the staff of one hundred, forty, including Van, remained loyal, but sixty, including Nod, joined the rebellion. The loyal staff preserved the tree of life and ascended to Jerusem, whereas the sixty rebels lost the life circuits, were reduced to the status of material mortals, and later became the ancestors of the "Nodites."

The fall and submergence of Dalamatia: When Caligastia rashly proclaimed "unlimited liberty," society rapidly regressed into savagery, and 162 years after the rebellion broke out, a great tidal wave swept over Dalamatia, and the whole city sank beneath the sea

q109.question: What is meant by the eleven-and-a-half-year sunspot cycle and the three-and-a-half-day brightness cycle?
q109.answer:
1. The Three-and-a-Half-Day (3.5-Day) Brightness Cycle

The upheavals and pulsations of the early sun: In the early days when the sun was forming, continuous contraction and rising internal temperature produced enormous upheavals and convulsions on the solar surface.

The 3.5-day cycle: At that time the sun swelled and contracted like a giant breath, and it took exactly three and a half days (3.5 days) to complete one cycle of changing brightness.

2. The Eleven-and-a-Half-Year (11.5-Year) Sunspot Cycle

The lengthening and stabilization of the pulsation cycle: As the sun gradually cooled and entered a relatively stable state, the powerful upheavals and pulsation cycle of its youth gradually diminished and lengthened; the legacy of this is the present 11.5-year sunspot cycle.

Evidence of a history as a variable star: The 11.5-year sunspot cycle observed today is therefore an indicator showing that our sun was in the past a variable star that pulsated periodically.

3. Cosmic Significance (the Occasion of the Solar System's Formation)

Sensitivity to outside influences: The state of a variable star pulsating on a three-and-a-half-day cycle made the surface of the sun very sensitive to outside gravitational stimuli.

The birth of the solar system (Monmatia): When the enormous Angona system approached about 4.5 billion years ago, at the moments of maximum expansion (upheaval) in the sun's three-and-a-half-day pulsation, the sun was subjected to a powerful gravitational pull, and enormous quantities of solar material were ejected into space; this became the decisive occasion for the condensation of this material into the planets of the present solar system, including the earth.

q110.question: Please explain in detail the origin, dispersion, and influence of the Andites as described in The Urantia Book.
q110.answer:
The Andites described in The Urantia Book were the most versatile and powerful primary blended race, the people who led the civilization of the earth and the biologic uplift of mankind in the post-Adamic age [78:0.1, 78:4.3].

The origin of the Andites, their worldwide dispersion, and the influence they left on modern civilization and on mankind are as follows.

1. The Origin and Character of the Andites

Racial composition: The Andites were a blended race, born when the pure-line violet race (the Adamites), the direct descendants of Adam and Eve, first united with the Nodites, the descendants of the rebel staff of Dalamatia, and when the evolutionary peoples (the Sangik colored races and the Andonites) were then added to this union [78:4.1, 78:4.2].

Standard of classification: The Urantia Book classifies as "Andite" those peoples whose total racial inheritance contained from one-eighth to one-sixth (about 12.5% to 16.6%) or more of violet (Adamic) blood [78:4.1].

Place and time of origin: They began to form about 25,000 B.C. on the periphery of the second garden in Mesopotamia and in the region of the Adamsonite headquarters near the Kopet mountains, south of the Caspian Sea [78:1.3, 78:4.2].

Racial characteristics:

The high intellect, peaceful tradition, and creative imagination of the Adamites combined with the military skill, adventurousness, and technical ability of the Nodites, and the Andites are therefore regarded as the finest and most versatile human stock in the history told by The Urantia Book [78:4.3, 78:4.5].

The early Andites were not themselves white (Caucasoid) or Aryan, but they laid the common biologic and cultural foundation of the later white races of Europe and western Asia [78:4.4].

2. The Eastward Expansion of the Andites (Asia, India, China, the Pacific, South America)

Driven by a restless instinct for roving and exploration, the Andites spread through central Asia and on across the whole of the East [78:4.6, 79:1.1].

Turkestan and central Asia:

In the highlands of Turkestan east of the Caspian Sea, in Sinkiang (the Tarim basin), and in Tibet they established the eastern frontier of true Andite culture [79:1.1, 79:1.2].

In this region the Andonic dialect blended with the language of the Adamsonites and Andites, and so began the "Aryan mother tongue" of the peoples who later conquered Europe and India [78:5.3].

When the drying of the climate brought severe drought about 8000 B.C., they built the great commercial metropolis of Adonia near Ashkhabad and developed commerce and urban culture [79:1.3, 79:1.4].

India (the Dravidians and the Aryan invasion):

First invasion (about 15,000 B.C.): The Andites who entered the valleys of the Indus and Ganges by way of Baluchistan blended with the natives to form the Dravidian civilization, and they led in city building and in sea trade across the Arabian Sea with Sumeria [79:2.4, 79:3.1, 79:3.7].

Second invasion (about 2500 B.C.): Andite cavalrymen pushing down from central Asia reconquered India under the name of Aryans, transplanting the Caspian and Sethite priestly tradition and the foundations of the caste system [79:4.1, 79:4.5, 79:4.6].

China (the acceleration of the Yellow River civilization):

About 15,000 B.C. the Andites entered the upper Yellow River (Kansu and Honan) through the pass of Ti Tao and intermarried with the northern yellow people [79:7.1].

Stimulated by the Andites, and with their able minds so quickened, the northern Chinese brought the Yellow River civilization to a level superior to that of the southern settlements on the Yangtze [79:7.2, 79:7.3].

Pacific voyages and South America (the ancestors of the Inca rulers):

One hundred and thirty-two Andites set out by boat from Japan across the Pacific and, passing through the Polynesian islands (Easter Island and others), reached the Andes of South America [78:5.7]. By union with the natives they became the ancestors of the later Inca rulers [78:5.7].

3. The Westward Expansion of the Andites (Europe, Egypt, the Aegean)

The westward expansion of the Andites determined the physical and cultural landscape of the European races [80:1.8, 80:4.1].

The invasion of Europe and the formation of the white (Caucasoid) races:

By about 12,000 B.C. three quarters of the world's Andites were living in northern and eastern Europe, and they entered Europe in seven major waves of invasion [78:5.4, 80:4.1].

In particular, the Andite cavalrymen who had succeeded in domesticating the horse passed across the Russian plains with superior mobility and military strategy, and they blended with and conquered the blue men (Cro-Magnons), the native peoples of Europe [80:4.4, 80:5.3, 80:5.4].

In this process the three great divisions of the modern white race were formed:

The Nordic race (northern white race): blue man + Andite blend (centered in Denmark and Scandinavia) [80:5.2, 80:9.2].

The Alpine race (central white race): Andonite + Andite + blue and yellow blend (broad-headed) [80:9.5, 80:9.7].

The Mediterranean race (southern white race): blue man + Andite + Saharan and secondary Sangik blend (long-headed, dark-skinned) [80:9.8, 80:9.10].

The Nile and Egyptian civilization:

Between about 8000 and 6000 B.C. Andite artisans and architects arriving from Mesopotamia settled in the Nile valley and raised the splendid civilization of Egypt, with its metalworking, irrigation techniques, and stone pyramid building (the prime minister Imhotep) [80:6.1, 80:6.3, 80:6.4].

Crete and Greece (the Aegean civilization):

About 12,000 B.C. a tribe of Andites crossed to the island of Crete and developed writing, textiles, metals, plumbing, and stone building [80:7.2].

Later an elite band of Adamsonites led by Sato, a direct descendant of Adamson and Ratta, moved to the Greek mainland and put down the roots of ancient Hellenic civilization, which became the basis of the Olympian myths [80:7.3, 80:7.5].

4. The Final Disappearance in the Mesopotamian Homeland and the Sumerians

The last three great dispersions (8000 to 6000 B.C.): Under climatic drought and the pressure of the outlying hill tribes, the last great migrations left the Mesopotamian homeland, scattering completely into Europe (65%), Elam and India (10%), Sinkiang and China (10%), and Egypt and Arabia (10%) [78:6.1-78:6.5].

The Sumerians: The last 5% of the Andites, who remained to the end at the mouths of the rivers and kept their racial purity and the Nodite and Dalamatian traditions, were the Sumerians [78:6.6, 78:8.1]. For a long time they defended themselves by their superior intelligence and their system of military canals, but by about 2000 B.C. they were wholly absorbed by the neighboring Semites and barbarian tribes, and the Andites of the Mesopotamian homeland vanished from history [78:8.5, 78:8.10].

5. The Influence of the Andites on Modern Civilization

Biologic uplift: By infusing the violet inheritance (the life plasm) of Adam and Eve into all the races of the world, they greatly raised mankind's brain power, vigor, resistance to disease, and physical and intellectual potential [51:3.6, 78:1.1, 81:5.1].

Industrial, technical, and agricultural revolution: They spread throughout the world the domestication of the horse, the cow, and the camel, the working of metals such as iron and brass, fired pottery, weaving, irrigation farming, and commercial and urban culture [78:5.8, 81:2.12, 81:3.1].

Language and writing: In Turkestan in central Asia they created the basis of the Aryan mother tongue (the Indo-European languages), and they spread writing (the alphabet) and the practice of keeping written records [78:3.8, 78:5.3].

Society and family culture: They introduced a fraternal and cooperative family-council practice in place of autocratic rule, and they firmly implanted in human life the sense of humor, play, adventure, art, and music [84:7.29, 84:8.3].

Religious and philosophical legacy: Through the work of the Sethite priesthood they left the second garden's concepts of the Trinity and of one God (monotheism) as a root of the religion of India (Brahmanism), of China (the worship of the One Truth and Taoism), of the Mediterranean (the mother cult), of Judaism, and of Western philosophy [79:3.3, 79:6.10, 80:7.7, 92:5.9].

q111.question: What were the geographical layout and the general situation of the second garden and the surrounding world about 35,000 years ago?
q111.answer:
The geographical layout and general situation of the second garden and the surrounding world about 35,000 years ago (immediately after Adam and Eve's default in the Garden of Eden) were as follows.

1. The Basic Geography of the Second Garden (Mesopotamia)

Central location: Having given up the first Garden of Eden, the Adamites moved to the fertile Mesopotamian plain between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and there established the second garden.

Natural defenses and the wall: To the south the two rivers served as a natural line of defense, and in the north, at the point where the two rivers came close together, a defense wall extending fifty-six miles (about 90 km) was built to keep out invasion by hostile outside tribes.

Cultural and religious center: Adam's son Eveson led in administration and culture, while Seth founded the Sethite priesthood, which had charge of religion, health, and education.

2. The Four Great Nodite and Adamsonite Strongholds around the Second Garden

Thirty-five thousand years ago the second garden was surrounded by the spheres of influence of the Nodites, descendants of the former staff of the Planetary Prince, and of the descendants of the Andonites:

North: the Adamsonite headquarters (Kopet Dagh):

This was the secondary northern center of the violet race, founded by Adam's eldest son Adamson at the foot of the Kopet mountains, east of the southern shore of the Caspian Sea.

To the north of it, around Mount Ararat and Lake Van, were gathered the loyal Vanites (the northern Nodites and Amadonites), who had once followed Van and Amadon.

West: the Syrian Nodites:

These were a Nodite group settled on the northeastern Syrian shores of the Mediterranean and in the Levant; they were the largest and most warlike of the groups.

East: the Elamite Nodites:

This group migrated to the highlands of Elam east of the Euphrates valley, united with the Sangik colored races, and maintained their commerce and culture.

South: the pre-Sumerian Nodites:

This group, settled at the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and along the Persian Gulf coast (the land of Nod and Dilmun), preserved longest their racial purity and the ancient culture of Dalamatia, and later became the ancestors of Sumerian civilization.

3. A Map of the Races and Civilizations of the Whole Earth 35,000 Years Ago

With the second garden at the center, the races and civilizations of the world of that day were distributed as follows:

The violet race (Adamites and Andites): Concentrated in the second garden in Mesopotamia and around the Kopet mountains, where they formed the cradle of civilization.

The blue man: Scattered all over Europe and the Mediterranean basin; absorbing the Neanderthals, they formed the most adventurous center of aboriginal culture.

The yellow man: In control of eastern Asia, with their most advanced settlements in the regions of northwestern China bordering on Tibet.

The red man: Had already crossed the Bering land bridge to the Americas some fifty thousand years before the arrival of Adam and lived there in isolation.

The indigo race (indigo man, the black man): Maintained superior cultural settlements on the Sahara plateau, at that time not a desert but a fertile grassland.

The Andonites: Scattered over northern Asia, the highlands of Turkestan, the mountains of Europe, and the far northern regions of Iceland and Greenland.

The Mediterranean and India: These were the border zones where the most intense racial mixing was taking place, as the blue men from the north, the Saharans from the south, and the Nodites and Adamites from the east came together.

q112.question: Please explain in detail the origin and dispersion of the Adamites.
q112.answer:
The origin and character of the Adamites (the violet race) described in The Urantia Book, their development in the second garden, and the historical process by which they expanded into the later Andites and dispersed throughout the world are as follows.

1. The Origin and Character of the Adamites (the Violet Race)

Arrival on earth and origin (about 38,000 years ago): About 38,000 years ago (37,848 years before A.D. 1934), Adam and Eve, a Material Son and Daughter sent as biologic uplifters, arrived on Urantia (the earth). Their direct offspring born in the first garden (the Garden of Eden) made up the pure violet race (the Adamites), the ninth race of Urantia.

Physical and spiritual characteristics: The Adamites stood eight to ten feet tall, their skin gave off a brilliant violet radiance, and they had blue eyes and light hair. They were highly intelligent; by means of gas chambers near their brain structures they could exchange thought over a distance of about fifty miles; and they possessed a spiritual receptivity suited to the Paradise ascent and a high resistance to disease. They also brought the sense of humor, music, and the culture of play to mankind for the first time.

The default and the move to the second garden: When Adam and Eve prematurely defaulted in their mission of racial uplift, they handed over the first garden to the Nodites and moved to the Mesopotamian plain between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, where they established the second garden. Here they had children, Seth among them, and for about thirty thousand years it was the cradle of Occidental civilization.

2. The Early Dispersion of the Adamites and the Second Center (the Adamsonites)

Peaceful migration as teachers and traders (25,000 to 15,000 B.C.): The early Adamites did not make wars of conquest. As their population grew, they went out as teachers, traders, and explorers under the guidance of the seraphim and the adjutant spirits, migrating among the surrounding evolutionary races and spreading their culture.

The northern headquarters of the Adamsonites: Adamson, the eldest son of Adam, was not content with life in the second garden and went north, where he founded the secondary northern center of the violet race at the foot of the Kopet mountains (Kopet Dagh), southeast of the Caspian Sea. Adamson married Ratta, a descendant of the Prince's staff; they became the ancestors of the secondary midway creatures, and the Adamsonites maintained a high civilization for seven thousand years.

Advance into central Asia: The Adamites moved north and settled in Turkestan, Sinkiang (the Tarim basin), and the Tibetan highlands, where they blended extensively with the Andonites and Nodites.

3. The Formation of the Andites

The birth of the primary blended race (about 25,000 B.C.): On the periphery of the second garden and in the Turkestan region, the pure-line violet race (the Adamites) united with the Nodites, and with the addition of superior evolutionary peoples (the Sangik colored races and the Andonites), the primary blended race called the Andites was born.

Definition of the stock: The peoples who had from one-eighth to one-sixth (about 12.5% to 16.6%) or more of violet blood in their racial inheritance are called Andites.

Powerful traits: The high intellect and the peaceful and creative imagination of the Adamites combined with the military skill and adventurousness of the Nodites, and they became the bravest and most versatile conquerors and carriers of culture then on earth.

4. The Second Great Dispersion of the Andites (15,000 to 2000 B.C.)

After the great flowering of the second garden about 15,000 B.C., the Andites began large-scale migrations and conquests throughout the world.

(1) Eastward expansion (Asia, India, China, the Pacific, South America)

Turkestan and the origin of the Aryan language: In the highlands of Turkestan the Andonic dialect blended with the Andite language, forming the beginnings of the "Aryan mother tongue" of the peoples who later conquered Europe and India.

India (the Dravidians and the Aryans): About 15,000 B.C. they entered India through Baluchistan and blended with the natives to raise the civilization of the Dravidians. About 2500 B.C. Andite cavalrymen coming down from central Asia reconquered India under the name of Aryans.

China (the Yellow River civilization): The Andites who entered the valley of the upper Yellow River, in Kansu and Honan, about 15,000 B.C. intermarried with the northern yellow people and greatly accelerated the development of the Yellow River civilization.

Pacific voyages and South America (the Inca Empire): One hundred and thirty-two Andites set out by boat across the Pacific, passed through the Polynesian islands, Easter Island among them, and reached the Andes of South America, where they blended with the natives and became the ancestors of the Inca ruling class.

(2) Westward expansion (Europe, Egypt, the Mediterranean)

The formation of the European white (Caucasoid) races: About 12,000 B.C. three quarters of the Andites moved in the direction of Europe. In particular, Andite cavalrymen who had domesticated the horse entered Europe in seven great waves and absorbed and conquered the blue men (Cro-Magnons), the native people. In this process the three main divisions of the modern white race (Nordic, Alpine, and Mediterranean) were formed.

Egyptian civilization: Andite artisans arriving from Mesopotamia brought to the Nile valley the stone pyramid, irrigation works, and metalworking techniques.

Cretan and Greek civilization: About 12,000 B.C. they crossed to the island of Crete and established a civilization of writing and architecture, and an elite band led by Sato, a direct descendant of Adamson, entered the Greek mainland and became the root of ancient Hellenic civilization.

(3) The Mesopotamian floods and the Sumerians

Submergence by the floods (about 5000 B.C.): With the rising of the northern highlands, great spring floods came year after year until the second garden was wholly under water and the Andite civilization of the homeland came to an end.

The Sumerians: The last 5% of the Andites, who remained to the end at the mouths of the rivers and kept their racial purity, became the Sumerians and maintained a brilliant urban civilization, but by about 2000 B.C. they had been absorbed by the neighboring Semites and others, and the Andites of Mesopotamia vanished from history.

5. The Legacy of the Adamites and Andites to Human Civilization

Biologic uplift: By infusing the life plasm of Adam into the races of the world, they greatly raised mankind's brain power, vigor, length of life, and resistance to disease.

Agricultural and industrial revolution: They spread throughout the world the wheat and barley of the garden, the art of horticulture, the working of metals such as iron and brass, weaving, fired pottery, and the domestication of the horse, the cow, and the camel.

Social and political institutions: They implanted the concept of fraternal representative government in place of despotic monarchy, together with the custom of the monogamous home.

Culture and religion: They left the tradition of the seven-day week and the Sabbath, the culture of humor, play, and music, and, through the Sethite priesthood, the ideas of one God and of the Trinity as a root of the religions of India, China, and Europe.

q113.question: Please explain in detail the origin and development of the Nodites.
q113.answer:
The Nodites described in The Urantia Book, the eighth race to appear in the earth's history, were a people of superhuman genetic inheritance, formed amid the upheaval of the Planetary Prince's rebellion, who laid the essential foundations of ancient civilization.

The origin, main divisions, and historical development of the Nodites, and their influence on human civilization, are as follows.

1. The Origin and Biologic Characteristics of the Nodites

Origin of the name: They take their name from Nod, the leader of the commission on industry and trade on the staff of the Planetary Prince Caligastia.

Rebellion and reduction to mortal status: At the time of the Lucifer-Caligastia rebellion about 200,000 years ago, sixty of the one hundred superhuman staff members joined the rebellion. They lost their connection with the life circuits of the system and were reduced to the status of mortals destined to die.

The formation of the Nodites (104 ancestors): To keep their numbers from dying out, the sixty rebel staff members and their forty-four associates among the modified Andonites (104 in all) began sexual reproduction, and so the ancestors of the Nodites came into being.

Mutant superiority: Through the influence of the Satania life circuits that had been at work in the bodies of the staff, the chemical constituents of their inheritance factors were modified, and they acquired mutant traits that made them far superior, physically, intellectually, and spiritually, to the Andonites and the Sangik colored races.

Mythical background (the "Nephilim"): Because of their superhuman qualities, the ancients remembered them as "gods" or as the "Nephilim" (the "mighty men of old"), and they were the actual background of the well-nigh universal folk tale of "⟦Q 77:2.3⟧the gods who came down to earth and there with the daughters of men begot an ancient race of heroes⟦/Q⟧."

2. The Early Headquarters of Dilmun and the Four Great Centers after the Tower of Babel

The building of the capital Dilmun: After the first world capital, Dalamatia, was submerged by a tidal wave, the Nodites moved northeast along the Persian Gulf and built their headquarters city of Dilmun.

The dispute over the tower of Babel and the dispersion: Long after the death of Nod, their leader Bablot undertook to erect a huge tower (the tower of Babel) commemorating the glory of the race, but internal dissension over its motive and purpose brought the work to a halt, and the tribes scattered throughout the world.

The four main Nodite centers (branches):

The western (Syrian) Nodites: This was the largest group, settling to the northwest of Mesopotamia (on the Syrian coast). They united with the Andonites and later became a principal basis of the Assyrian stock. (Serapatatia and Laotta, who were involved in Eve's default, came from this branch.)

The eastern (Elamite) Nodites: They migrated to the highlands of Elam, east of the Euphrates valley, united with the Sangik tribes, and maintained a high level of commerce and culture.

The central (pre-Sumerian) Nodites: They remained at the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and preserved their racial integrity longest. These later united with the Adamites and became the Sumerians of history.

The northern Nodites and the Vanites: This group, in the region of Lake Van and Mount Ararat, refused Nod's rebellion and followed the loyal leaders Van and Amadon. They carried on the pure religion and traditions of Dalamatia.

3. Relations with the Adamites and Union into the Andites

The building of the Garden of Eden and the default: Before the arrival of Adam and Eve, the Nodites and Amadonites were the most civilized peoples on earth, and they played a central part in building the first Garden of Eden to receive the Adamites. But the impatience of the Nodite leaders Serapatatia and Cano led to Eve's default, and as a result long and hostile warfare continued between the Adamites and the Nodites.

The formation of the Andites: After the Adamites moved to the second garden in Mesopotamia, the pure violet race (the Adamites) united with the Nodites, and with the addition of superior evolutionary peoples there arose the Andites, the bravest and most versatile primary blended race in the history of the earth.

Military and administrative contribution: When the peaceful and creative intelligence of the Adamites was joined to the characteristic belligerence, military skill, and adventurousness of the Nodites, the Andites became the powerful agents of civilization who expanded across the world.

4. Historical Revival as Sumerian Civilization

The identity of the Sumerians: The last 5% of the Nodite and Andite remnant, who about 6000 B.C. refused to leave their Mesopotamian homeland and stayed to the end at the mouths of the rivers, were the Sumerians.

The revival of the heritage of Dalamatia: They preserved the alphabet of the days of Dalamatia, pottery making, metalworking, irrigation canals, law, agriculture, and building techniques, together with the paradise tradition of Dilmun, and so at the beginning of the historical era they suddenly displayed a mature and superior culture.

Influence on the Biblical tradition: The records of the Nodites and Sumerians (the tradition of Dilmun, the tower of Babel, the record of the Mesopotamian floods, and others) passed later through the Hebrew priests of the Babylonian captivity into the book of Genesis and the story of Noah's flood in the Old Testament.

In summary, the Nodites were a race born with the superhuman inheritance of the rebel staff of the Planetary Prince. They passed through Dilmun and the tower of Babel, developed into the Syrian, Elamite, pre-Sumerian, and Vanite branches, and later, in union with the Adamites, became the direct biologic and cultural foundation of the Andites and of Sumerian civilization.

q114.question: Please explain in detail the origin, development, and characteristics of the Sumerians.
q114.answer:
The Sumerians described in The Urantia Book were a people who appeared in Mesopotamia suddenly displaying a mature civilization. Their origin, cultural development, and historical end are as follows.

1. The Origin and Ancestry of the Sumerians

The last remnant of the Andites: At the time of the great Andite migrations about 8000 to 6000 B.C., the last 5% of the Andites, who refused to leave their Mesopotamian homeland and stayed to the end in the coastal district at the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, were the Sumerians.

Inheritors of a superhuman genetic legacy: They kept a high proportion of superior Nodite and Adamite (violet race) blood, and by avoiding intermarriage with the inferior barbarian tribes around them they preserved their racial purity and outstanding intelligence.

The cultural roots of Dalamatia and Dilmun: Their origin seems mysterious to archaeology because their actual cultural roots go back to Dalamatia, the first capital of the earth, which sank beneath the sea about 200,000 years ago, and to the tradition of Dilmun, founded by the Nodites after the rebellion.

2. Cultural and Technical Characteristics

The sudden appearance of a mature civilization: When the Sumerians came on the stage of history they already possessed temple building, metalwork, agriculture, the raising of animals, pottery making, weaving, civil codes and commercial law, religious ceremonial, and a distinctive system of writing.

Language and writing: They had lost the old alphabet of Dalamatia but used the peculiar wedge-shaped writing system originating in Dilmun. Their language was not Semitic; it had much in common with the so-called Aryan tongues.

Advanced technology and medicine: Centered on Ur, they developed an excellent pottery industry, and they were skilled in working iron, copper, and brass. In medicine as well, they used castor oil and opium as remedies.

Irrigation canals and military defense: They built an extensive network of canals and irrigation pools that not only raised agricultural productivity but also served as a complete means of military defense.

The Dilmun paradise tradition: They remembered Dilmun as the "earthly paradise" "⟦Q 77:4.8⟧where the Gods first blessed mankind with the example of civilized and cultured life⟦/Q⟧," and they left elaborate records of it. They also knew of the first and second Edens of the Adamites, but in their pride in the more ancient Nodite culture they regarded the garden dwellers as an alien race.

3. Development, Historical Absorption, and Legacy

Prosperity during the floods: Even during the Mesopotamian floods of about 5000 B.C., settlements such as Susa and Ur, relying on their skill in irrigation and flood control, flourished all the more as centers of art and craft.

Relations with the northern conquerors: When barbarian horsemen came down from Turkestan and the north and overran all of Mesopotamia, the Sumerians at the mouths of the rivers were not conquered; they defended themselves by their superior intelligence, their weapons, and their network of irrigation canals. Instead of conquering these peace-loving Sumerians, the invaders prized and respected them as able teachers, administrators, and directors of commerce.

The age of the city-states and the unification under Sargon: Because each city served its own municipal god, the jealousies among the Sumerian city-states long kept them from forming a powerful political confederation, and they lay under the weak rule of priests. Then Sargon of Kish proclaimed himself king and unified all of Mesopotamia into an empire.

Decline and final absorption: After capitals such as Lagash were invaded about 2500 B.C., they gradually weakened, and by the time of Hammurabi, about 2000 B.C., they had been wholly absorbed by the northern Semites, and the Andite-Sumerians vanished from history as a distinct race.

Historical legacy: Although the people themselves were absorbed, their irrigation techniques, system of commercial credit, law, and the traditions of Dilmun and the flood passed to the Semites, the Babylonians, the Egyptians, and the Hebrew literature of the Old Testament, and became a foundation of modern civilization.

q115.question: Please explain the sevenfold salvation that Jesus brought.
q115.answer:
According to Paper 101 of The Urantia Book (The Real Nature of Religion), the faith and teaching of Jesus, grounded in a perfect harmony of knowledge, wisdom, faith, truth, and love, offer human beings a sevenfold salvation (Sevenfold Salvation).

The specific content of the seven salvations and liberations that Jesus set forth is as follows:

The Seven Salvations That Jesus Brought (Sevenfold Salvation)

1. Salvation from material bondages

By realizing personal sonship with God, who is spirit, one is set free from the limitations of the material organism and from the bondages of the flesh.

2. Salvation from intellectual bondages

As in the saying "ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free," by recognizing divine truth one escapes the bondage of ignorance, intellectual blindness, and misunderstanding.

3. Salvation from spiritual blindness

On earth one comes to realize the brotherhood of mortals, and on the morontia level one becomes conscious of the brotherhood of all created beings of the universe. Through unselfish service one discovers spiritual reality and experiences the goodness of divine values.

4. Salvation from self-imperfection

By attaining the spiritual levels of the universe step by step, one finally comes to realize the harmony of Havona, the central universe, and the divine perfection of Paradise.

5. Salvation from self

By attaining the cosmic level of the Supreme mind and by harmoniously associating with all other self-conscious beings, one is delivered from the limitations of a selfish and narrow self-consciousness.

6. Salvation from time

In the midst of recognizing God and serving in love, one obtains eternal life, ever progressing and growing, and is thereby liberated from the limitations and extinction of time.

7. Salvation from finiteness

One attains complete oneness with God in the Supreme, and participates in the boundless cosmic adventure of continually discovering the Ultimate on the transcendental (absonite) level.

The Cosmic Meaning of the Sevenfold Salvation

These seven salvations embody a completeness that corresponds to the realization of the ultimate experience of the Universal Father. By accepting the faith of Jesus as their own faith, human beings, though living in the finite material realms of space and time, experience the realities of eternity in advance within time and obtain the divine inheritance of being sons of the eternal God.

q116.question: Please tell me the difference between the ‘religion of the mind’ and the ‘religion of the spirit’.
q116.answer:
The Difference Between the ‘Religion of the Mind’ and the ‘Religion of the Spirit’

The differences between the two religions set forth in The Urantia Book, Paper 155, section 5, paragraphs 2–12, and section 6, paragraphs 3–9, and in Paper 101, section 5, paragraphs 3–4, are as follows.

1. The Source of Origin and Authority

Religion of the mind (religion of authority / religion of civilization): a religion based on humanity’s advanced religious concepts, on intellectual theology, and on the authority of the church (155:5.4, 155:5.6, 101:5.3).

Religion of the spirit (religion of revelation / true religion): it is based on revelation of supernatural values and on the living personal experience of the divine spirit dwelling in the human mind (155:5.5, 155:5.6, 155:5.12, 101:5.4).

2. The Attitude Required of the Believer

Religion of the mind: it requires of the formal believer only a simple intellectual assent to tradition and doctrine, and demands little spiritual effort (155:5.8, 155:5.11).

Religion of the spirit: it requires a daring venture of faith advancing toward untrodden truth, decision, spiritual struggle, and loving service and progress (155:5.8, 155:5.11).

3. Spiritual Freedom and Security

Religion of the mind: it offers a temporary sense of security by resting in the traditions of the past, but at the price of the loss of spiritual and religious freedom (155:5.11, 155:6.5).

Religion of the spirit: it bestows an eternal spiritual freedom that boldly follows truth wherever the leading of the spirit goes (155:6.5).

4. Human Unity and the Realization of Brotherhood

Religion of the mind: bound to racial viewpoints and lifeless creeds, it divides people, and because it demands uniformity of intellectual belief it can never be unified (155:6.4, 155:6.8, 155:6.9).

Religion of the spirit: while allowing diversity of intellectual views, it is the only unifying force that, through the same divine spirit dwelling within every human being, leads people to understand and sympathize with one another as one brotherhood of man (155:6.8, 155:6.9)

q117.question: How does the ‘religion of the spirit’ that Jesus demonstrated cooperate with the indwelling spirit (the Thought Adjuster) and the Spirit of Truth to bear spiritual fruit?
q117.answer:
1. The Roles and Cooperative Structure of the Triple Spirit Within the Mind

Within the believer, three divine spiritual influences of different origins cooperate in perfect unity.

Thought Adjuster: a fragment of spirit given directly by the Universal Father into the superconscious realm of the mortal mind [107:0.1]. It makes the human being aspire to God’s divine perfection, and serves as an inner compass that spiritualizes daily choices into the eternal values of the morontia soul [107:0.2, 111:1.4].

Spirit of Truth: the spirit that Christ Michael poured out upon all flesh on the day of Pentecost [194:2.3]. Within the heart of the believer it reinterprets and reveals, with true living power, the truth of Jesus’ life on earth and of his teachings, and it assures the believer that he is in fact a child of God [146:3.6, 194:3.1].

Holy Spirit: the ministry of the Mother Spirit of the local universe; it provides the basis for connecting the human mind, grown up through the adjutant mind-spirits, to the spiritual circuit and for sanctifying it [34:4.3, 34:5.3].

The perfect unity of the spirit: although these three spirits differ in origin and nature, within the human mind and soul they function as one spirit, not as separate factions, harmoniously and perfectly integrated [8:5.4, 34:5.7, 194:2.11].

2. The Concrete Techniques of Spiritual Cooperation (How They Work)

The consent of the human will and moral choice: the divine spirit does not coerce human autonomy but guides gently [34:6.11]. When the believer makes the decision to choose truth, beauty, and goodness beyond selfish animal desires, a spiritual fulcrum is formed by which the Adjuster can spiritualize and elevate the human being [108:5.4, 111:1.1].

The union and spiritualization of ideas: when the Thought Adjuster spiritualizes the ideas and decisions that the mortal mind has brought, the Spirit of Truth interprets them in terms of Paradise truth and the law of unselfish love (the spiritual realization of the golden rule), and extends them throughout the whole of life [101:3.2, 180:5.8].

The inner testimony of sonship: the Thought Adjuster speaks within of kinship with God, and the Spirit of Truth and the Holy Spirit, together with the believer’s spirit, bear witness that he is truly a son possessing God the Father, bestowing spiritual freedom and joy [34:6.12, 146:3.6].

3. The Fundamental Differences Between the Religion of the Mind and the Religion of the Spirit

Source and authority: the religion of the mind (the religion of authority) rests on the established intellectual theology of the civilized races and on the traditional authority of the church [155:5.4]. The religion of the spirit (the religion of revelation), on the other hand, rests on revelation of supernatural values and on the living personal experience with the divine spirit dwelling within the human being [155:5.5].

The attitude required: the religion of the mind requires only a passive intellectual assent to established doctrine [155:5.8]. The religion of the spirit, on the other hand, requires a bold venture of faith advancing toward untrodden truth, decision, spiritual struggle, and the service of unselfish love [155:5.8, 155:5.11].

Spiritual freedom: the religion of the mind gives a temporary sense of relief by resting in tradition, but causes the loss of spiritual freedom [155:6.5]. The religion of the spirit, on the other hand, bestows an eternal spiritual freedom that boldly follows truth wherever the leading of the spirit goes [155:6.5].

Human unity: the religion of the mind divides people by imposing lifeless creeds and uniformity of intellectual views [155:6.8, 155:6.9]. The religion of the spirit, on the other hand, while allowing diversity of intellectual views, binds all humanity into one brotherhood through the same divine spirit dwelling within each [155:6.8, 155:6.9].

4. The Concrete Spiritual Fruits Borne in Life (Spiritual Fruits)

The list of the fruits of the spirit: in a life that has accepted the leading of the spirit willingly and intelligently, the fruits of the divine spirit are harvested naturally, even without forced observance of formal rules [34:6.13, 193:2.2]. These include loving service, joy, peace, longsuffering (patience), gentleness (ministry of mercy), goodness (unfailing goodness), faith (open-hearted trust), meekness, temperance (self-mastery), unselfish devotion, courageous loyalty, sincere fairness, enlightened honesty, undying hope, and forgiving tolerance [34:6.13, 193:2.2].

Loving service of unselfish love toward fellow human beings: just as the branches of the vine exist in order to bear fruit, the believer who has experienced Jesus’ religion of the spirit shares the divine love received from God with fellow men in the loving service of unselfish love, and thereby completes the true purpose of life and the fruit of salvation [102:3.4, 180:2.5]

q118.question: What cosmic and social changes freed humanity from religious discrimination and social class after the Spirit of Truth was poured out at Pentecost?
q118.answer:
The bestowal of the Spirit of Truth poured out on the day of Pentecost went beyond the spiritual salvation of the individual; it was a decisive turning point that freed humanity, on the cosmic, social, and historical levels, from long bondage and discrimination.

1. Liberation and Change on the Cosmic Level

The foundation for the universal indwelling of the Thought Adjuster (the Father's spirit): With the outpouring of the Spirit of Truth at Pentecost, the cosmic prerequisites and foundation were completed by which the Thought Adjuster, a fragment of the Paradise Father's spirit, could indwell every normal mortal mind on earth [20:5.3], [34:5.4], [108:6.2].

Eternal deliverance from evil spirits and demon possession: Because the Spirit of Truth was poured out upon all flesh, even the weakest and most ignorant human mind was permanently safeguarded, on a cosmic scale, so that disloyal or evil spirits could never again invade and dominate it [77:7.7-7.8].

The perfect cooperative system of the threefold spirit completed: After Pentecost every believer came to enjoy wisely the universal ministry and guidance of the threefold spirit: the indwelling Thought Adjuster (the Father's spirit), the Spirit of Truth (the Son's spirit), and the Holy Spirit (the Mother Spirit) [34:5.7], [194:2.11].

2. Liberation from Social Class and Sex Discrimination

Women's full spiritual and religious equality achieved: In the ancient religions before Pentecost, women had little or no spiritual standing or were discriminated against; but among the hundred and twenty gathered in the upper room on the day of Pentecost were many women disciples, and they received the gift of the Spirit in exactly the same way as the men [194:3.14]. Thus, within the brotherhood of Jesus' kingdom, women were freed forever from all religious discrimination based on sex and gained a standing fully equal to that of men before God [194:3.14].

The abolition of caste and the barriers of social class: In the kingdom of heaven there is no social class, no caste, and no difference of economic status [134:4.7]. Without distinction between Jew and gentile, rich and poor, free and slave, all who believe the truth were established as equal brothers, sons and daughters of God [138:4.2], [143:1.5], [194:3.14].

The end of the hereditary priestly class and system: Pentecost ended the ancient superstition about a special priesthood or holy families [194:3.15]. True religion was released from the monopoly of particular priests or classes and became a personal experience, direct communion with God in the soul of each individual [194:3.6].

3. Historical and Civilizational Freedom and the Unification of Humanity

The separation of politics and religion, and intellectual and religious freedom: The spread of the Spirit of Truth brought about the gradual separation of politics and religion, and became a powerful social lever that has granted true intellectual and religious freedom to all peoples in history [178:1.9].

The unification of humanity by spiritual forces: The Spirit of Truth works as a powerful worldwide unifying influence that binds all humanity into one, not by physical force or national compulsion, but through a ministry of unsurpassed goodwill and unselfish love [194:3.11-3.12], [194:3.17].

q119.question: What is the historical spread of the Spirit of Truth that began at Pentecost, and what is the meaning of the "spiritual renaissance" that rediscovers Jesus' original gospel?
q119.answer:
The historical process by which the Spirit of Truth, poured out on the day of Pentecost, spread, and the concrete meaning of the rediscovery of Jesus' original gospel required in modern society (the "spiritual renaissance"), are as follows.

1. The Historical Spread of the Spirit of Truth

The Pentecostal outpouring and its universal spread: When the Spirit of Truth was first poured out on the hundred and twenty believers in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost, true religion was freed from the monopoly of priests and a holy class and was delivered to all humanity as a universal personal gift [194:0.1, 194:3.6].

Liberation from national and racial shackles: Through Pentecost, the religion of Jesus broke the Jewish context, the shackles of nation and race, and the discrimination of class and sex, and gained the spiritual freedom to go out into the whole world [194:3.5, 194:3.14].

Hellenization and the move to gentile Western civilization: Through Peter and Paul and the Greek believers, the message spread throughout the Roman Empire [195:0.1]. In this process, combining with Greek philosophy (Plato, Philo) and Roman elements, it formed the moral and philosophical foundation of Western civilization [98:7.10, 195:0.14].

Institutionalization and preservation in a "cocoon": As the gospel spread, the original gospel that Jesus had proclaimed (the Fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of men) was gradually transformed into the religion about Jesus (church theology), which makes Jesus the object of worship [170:5.19, 194:0.4]. Although the institutionalized church lost some of its early spiritual purity in doctrine and form, through the dark ages of history and the storms of secularization it served as a cocoon preserving the truth of the life and teachings of Jesus [170:5.21, 195:4.3-4.4].

2. Modern Society and the Meaning of the "Spiritual Renaissance"
